behavior.arguments: rdi and rsi each point at a struct; each struct's +8 field points at a second struct. No argument is written.
behavior.distinction_from_packet_65: Packet #65 (0x5361710) selects one of two fields from a single two-hop base (p=[rdi+8], q=[p+0x1e0], q nonzero then [q+8] else [p+0x178]). This window compares the same deep field (+0x78) of two distinct two-hop structs (rdi-side vs rsi-side) and returns a comparison byte; it selects nothing and writes nothing.

edges.both_equal: First and second deep fields equal -> 0.
edges.second_above: Second deep field above the first -> 0.
edges.second_below: Second deep field below the first -> 1.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; no branches, no calls: mov 0x8(%rdi),%rax; mov 0x8(%rsi),%rdx; mov 0x78(%rax),%rax; cmp %rax,0x78(%rdx); setb %al; ret.
behavior.return_rule: %al = 1 exactly when [[rsi+8]+0x78] < [[rdi+8]+0x78] as unsigned qwords, else 0. Only %al is written by setb; the upper bytes of rax are the high bytes of the loaded first deep field and no zero-extended boolean is claimed.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.caller_setup: Immediately before the call: add %rbx,%rcx; add %rbx,%rdi (preceded by mov %rax,%r8; mov %r8,%rdi; mov %r10,%rsi; shl $0x4,%rcx; shl $0x4,%rdi). Caller purpose is not claimed.
incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; exactly one site found, confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
